name: Chairman Mao inspects the countryside in Guangdong
summary: "Chairman Mao inspects the countryside in Guangdong", poster, photographic reproduction of painting by Chen Yanning (1945-), published by Remin meishu chubanshe in Beijing, 1972. The work shows Mao walking on the path of a rice-field, surrounded by a crowd of farmers.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
